We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

**Position Summary**  
  
We are seeking a highly skilled and visionary Staff Engineer to lead the architecture, development, and scaling of our core applications. In this role, you will bridge the gap between complex backend data systems, emerging AI capabilities, and intuitive frontend experiences.

As a hands-on technical leader, you will be responsible for designing rich, interactive dashboards, building resilient backend microservices, and orchestrating deep integrations with diverse data objects and third-party systems. You will champion our DevOps culture and lead the charge in embedding AI-driven features into our product suite to automate workflows and deliver intelligent insights.

Sitting at the intersection of application development, data integration, and cloud operations, you will guide technical strategy, mentor engineering teams, and ensure operational excellence across the entire technology stack. This position will focus on optimizing our Payer Operations with the goal of building solutions that enrich our Payer metadata, automate our Payer lifecycle contracts, and measure Payer performance.

* Architecture & Full Stack Development: Lead the end-to-end design, architecture, and development of highly scalable web applications, from responsive, user-centric frontends to robust backend services.
* Dashboarding & Data Visualization: Architect and implement rich, interactive dashboards and user interfaces that surface complex data insights in an intuitive, performant, and accessible manner.

jobs.title: Cloud Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
**The Opportunity:**

We are seeking a highly skilled Software Engineer with expertise in cloud-native architecture, Infrastructure as Code, DevSecOps, and distributed systems engineering to support the development of mission-critical cyber operations capabilities. This role combines hands-on software engineering with technical leadership responsibilities, driving the design, development, integration, and deployment of scalable cloud-based solutions that enable the coordination and orchestration of complex cyber missions.

  

As a key member of a high-performing Agile team, you will work alongside architects, technical leads, developers, data scientists, and cybersecurity professionals to modernize legacy systems and deliver innovative mission solutions. You will be responsible for designing and implementing secure, resilient, and automated cloud architectures while ensuring technical execution aligns with architectural objectives and customer mission requirements.

  

We’re looking for someone with a strong software engineering background, practical experience developing cloud-native applications and Infrastructure as Code solutions, and a passion for exploring emerging technologies across software, cloud, networking, containerization, and DevSecOps platforms.

  

**What You’ll Work On:**

* Develop and deliver cloud-native software solutions using modern programming languages, microservices architectures, and Infrastructure as Code practices.
* Design, automate, and manage cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, container platforms, and deployment environments to enable secure and reliable software delivery.
* Lead system architecture and technical decision-making, ensuring solutions meet scalability, security, performance, and operational requirements.
* Integrate and orchestrate diverse software, networking, cloud, and cybersecurity technologies into cohesive mission-focused platforms.
